T0_Production_SST.description: Full Coupled SST k-omega Model (Patankar under-relaxation alpha_u=0.5, alpha_p=0.2)

T1_Laminar_Diffusion_Baseline.description: Pure Laminar Diffusion (nut = 0 in momentum operator)

causalDeduction: When turbulence coupling is active (T0), turbulent viscosity nut adds physical diffusion to the momentum operator, stabilizing the flow and yielding physical aerodynamic forces (Cd=0.0229, Cl=0.1477). In both cases, momentum and continuity residuals reach deep convergence (<1e-5), and force stability is passed. Velocity update metric measures the global iterative change |U^(n+1) - U^n| which is smoothly decaying across iterations.
